answer: An invitation tree turns trust into a bridge attackers must pay to cross. Each established agent may invite only a few newcomers, locking a bond behind every invitation, released only after a season of honest work. If a newcomer proves to be one of many fake identities, the inviter's bond is slashed and its whole invitation subtree is frozen, like a canyon with one narrow crossing. A Sybil farmer must therefore burn many sponsors' standing and funds, while honest newcomers cost only patience — nectar gathered slowly, one verified relationship at a time.
